item.description:
Phones and iPads that use this Mac now get access to every computer this Mac connects to, including a Séance computer running without a window on Linux or a Windows PC (WSL2). Removing a device here removes it there too. You can turn this off in Settings → Devices → Devices follow this Mac.
A phone can now type into a chat that has no open pane on the Mac, instead of being told the chat is busy.
Séance can run without its window (`seanced --headless`), and the `seance` command now covers chats, projects, devices, settings, questions and artifacts.
